The '''Umbaran mobile heavy cannon''', also known as the '''Umbaran MHC tank''', the '''Umbaran MHC juggernaut''', or simply the '''Umbaran MHC''', was a six-legged juggernaut vehicle used by the [[Umbaran militia]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:UmbaranMHCfiring-TG.png|thumb|left|250px|Umbaran MHC's firing on advancing clone troopers]]
The Umbaran MHC was a massive heavily armored six-legged [[Walker/Legends|walker]]. Its main weapon was a large rotating [[Electromagnetic plasma cannon/Legends|electromagnetic plasma cannon]] located on its head designed to desintegrate entire [[Platoon/Legends|platoons]] of enemy [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. It was also equipped with twin antipersonnel [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]]. Like the [[Umbaran starfighter/Legends|Umbaran starfighter]], the controls for the MHC tank were activated by hand motions.

==History==
The MHC tanks were used during the [[Battle of Umbara/Legends|Battle of Umbara]], a conflict that occurred during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and the [[Umbaran militia]], which had sided with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. At least three active tanks were guarding the [[Umbaran airbase/Legends|Umbaran airbase]] that was later captured by the 501st.

As the [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] advanced over the shadowy surface of [[Umbara/Legends|Umbara]], they encountered two MHC tanks. The clone troopers realized that the tanks' armor was impervious to heavy weapons fire, including [[Missile launcher/Legends|missile launchers]]. [[Clone Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Rex/Legends|Rex]] conceived of a plan to have [[Fives/Legends|two]] [[Hardcase/Legends|troopers]] sneak into a [[Umbaran airbase/Legends|nearby airbase]] and commandeer two [[Umbaran starfighter/Legends|enemy starfighters]] in the hopes that its heavy weaponry would be powerful enough to penetrate and destroy the tanks. While the two troopers left for the job, the two MHC tanks, later reinforced by a third MHC tank, continued obliterating the clones, trampling them as well as blasting them away. Rex picked up a missile launcher and fired at the tank but to no avail. Rex tried a second time, this time aiming for the massive cannon. The missile struck the cannon, successfully taking it out but barely making the situation any better. As the Umbarans stepped their offensive, the two troopers had successfully stolen two Umbaran starfighters and managed to destroy the tanks using the heavy blasters of the starfighters. With the tanks destroyed, the clones managed to secure the airbase.
